title: Metabolic signatures of T cells in polyomavirus-associated nephropathy (PyVAN): comparison of immunosuppressive drugs and adaptation strategies
summary: Das Projekt zielt darauf ab, durch präzisionsmedizinische Ansätze die Transplantatfunktion nach Nierentransplantationen zu optimieren. Dazu soll die BKV-spezifische zelluläre Immunität auf Einzelzellniveau umfassend charakterisiert werden.

interventions.name:
Kidney transplant patients with BK viremia:
Patients and healthy volunteers who meet the inclusion criteria are offered participation in the study by their attending physician during an outpatient visit to the kidney transplant outpatient clinic of the Nephrology Department at the University Hospit

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Have had a kidney transplant or are planning to have a kidney transplant from a living donor
- Do not have hepatitis B/C and/or HIV
Exclusion criteria:
- Minor age
- Lack of capacity to consent
- Viral infections such as hepatitis B, hepatitis C, and/or HIV
- Pregnancy
